## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The [KR5c0143](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0143) Daozang edition is the **more complete version** of Dù Dàojiān's *Zuǎn yì* commentary on the *Wénzǐ* — containing all 12 *piān*, where the WYG [KR5c0119](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0119) is missing 5 *piān* (*Dào yuán*, *Jiǔ shǒu*, *Dào dé*, *Shàng rén*, *Shàng lǐ*).

See [KR5c0119](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0119) for the comprehensive treatment of the work — its editorial method (collecting pre-Sòng commentators including Xú Língfǔ), its philosophical character (extending Dù Dàojiān's *Dàodé jīng* work to the *Wénzǐ*), its date (c. 1310), and its significance for *Wénzǐ* scholarship. The two catalog entries refer to the same work in two different transmission witnesses; [KR5c0143](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0143) is the Daozang version (complete), [KR5c0119](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0119) the WYG version (partially reconstructed from *Yǒng lè dà diǎn*).

**Abstract**

[KR5c0143](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0143) is the **primary and most complete** edition of Dù Dàojiān's *Wénzǐ zuǎn yì*. Together with [KR5c0119](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0119) (the WYG reconstruction), it constitutes our evidence for one of the most important Yuán commentaries on the *Wénzǐ*.

**Dating.** 1310. Per the project's dating rule, the frontmatter gives **1310** as the composition date. Dynasty: 元.
